name: snappyai-publisher-simple
description: Stripe webhook -> entitlement state -> signed entitlements.json in the public repo. Storage is one JSON file; there is no database.
comment: Archive layout: this dev project lives in worker/publisher-simple/source/; the deployable bundle it generates is worker/publisher-simple/worker.js; the tests live in tests/ at the archive root. No RUNTIME dependencies: tweetnacl is vendored as ESM in src/vendor/. `npm test` (from tests/) works without npm install; rebuilding the bundle (`npm run bundle`) or running `npm run typecheck` here needs `npm install` once.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.editorcheck.json && echo 'dashboard editor check: 0 problems'
